title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: kdominant
text:
K-dominant match
K-dominant match
(definition)
Definition:
A match [i,j] having rank k and such that for any other pair [i',j'] of rank k either i'>i and j'≤ j or i' ≤ i and j'>j.
Note:
From Algorithms and Theory of Computation Handbook, page 13-18, Copyright © 1999 by CRC Press LLC. Appearing in the Dictionary of Computer Science, Engineering and Technology, Copyright © 2000 CRC Press LLC.
